parameters.content:
## Client Onboarding Automation
Automate new-client onboarding end to end. When a client submits your intake form, this workflow confirms receipt, sends a branded welcome email, books a kickoff call, alerts your team, logs the client, and follows up with a satisfaction survey 30 days later.

### How it works
1. A **Webhook** receives the intake-form submission and instantly returns a 200 response.
2. A **Set** node normalises the fields and calculates the onboarding, welcome-call, and survey dates.
3. In parallel it sends a **welcome email** (Gmail), creates a **Google Calendar** welcome call, posts to **Slack**, and logs the client to **Google Sheets**.
4. After a **30-day wait** it emails a satisfaction survey, marks the row as sent, and notifies Slack.
5. Client-facing steps route any failure to a shared **Slack error alert**.

### Setup
1. Connect your Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, and Slack credentials (OAuth2 — no API keys).
2. Select your spreadsheet and tab in both Google Sheets nodes.
3. Pick your channels in the three Slack nodes and your calendar in the Calendar node.
4. Point your intake form at the Webhook production URL. Expected JSON body: firstName, lastName, email, company, phone, services[], bizSize, description, referral, submittedAt.
5. Replace `YOUR_SURVEY_LINK_HERE` in the survey email and update the branding.

### Customization
Change the **Wait** node to adjust follow-up timing, and edit the email templates to match your brand.

## 1. Intake & instant response
Receives the form POST, returns 200 immediately, then normalises the client data and dates.

## 2. Automated onboarding actions
In parallel: welcome email, Google Calendar kickoff call, Slack team alert, and Google Sheets log.

## 3. Logging + 30-day feedback loop
Logs the client, waits 30 days, emails the survey, marks the row as sent, and alerts Slack.

## ⚠️ Error handling
Client-facing steps route failures here so the team can finish onboarding manually.
